inputs.goal: Discover the Kubernetes cluster resources, deploy a MiniCluster of the same number of nodes and maximum cores available to the default namespace. Use the container ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:kripke. Run Kripke. You MUST maximize the final reported Grind Time Figure of Merit. Change parameters as you need. kind: MiniCluster

  name: minicluster-1
  namespace: default

  size: 1
  tasks: 64

apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: flux-operator
  namespace: default
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: flux-operator-role
  namespace: default
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["pods", "pods/log", "services", "configmaps", "secrets"]
  verbs: ["get", "list", "watch", "create", "update", "patch", "delete"]
- apiGroups: ["batch"]
  resources: ["jobs"]
  verbs: ["get", "list", "watch", "create", "update", "patch", "delete"]
- apiGroups: ["flux-framework.org"]
  resources: ["miniclusters"]
  verbs: ["get", "list", "watch", "create", "update", "patch", "delete"]
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: flux-operator-rolebinding
  namespace: default
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: operator-controller-manager
  namespace: operator-system
roleRef:
  kind: Role
  name: flux-operator-role
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
